يبتلين (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلِينَ (yabtalīna) /jab.ta.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# يُبْتَلَيْنَ (yubtalayna) /jub.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
